omittedStates.Loaded: Default documents the ordinary loaded field; a duplicate canonical story would add no distinct contract.
omittedStates.Refreshing: The field receives one loading flag and does not distinguish initial option loading from refresh ownership.
omittedStates.Empty: No-options presentation is exercised through existing interaction stories and remains MUI popup behavior.
omittedStates.Error: Option request errors and retry controls are owned by the consuming query region adjacent to the retained field.
omittedStates.AlignmentContract: The retained control frame is Level A and protected by the representative autocomplete loading test rather than a duplicate family story.

omittedStates.Loaded: Default documents the idle action and its transition to the next step.
omittedStates.Refreshing: Busy actions do not own refresh state.
omittedStates.Empty: Actions do not own an empty state.
omittedStates.Error: Step validation errors remain owned by the form and field error surfaces.
omittedStates.AlignmentContract: MUI Button preserves the action footprint while loading and focused tests protect the retained button contract.

omittedStates.Loaded: Default documents the idle submit action and real form submission lifecycle.
omittedStates.Refreshing: Busy actions do not own refresh state.
omittedStates.Empty: Actions do not own an empty state.
omittedStates.Error: Submission errors remain owned by the form or consuming mutation surface.
omittedStates.AlignmentContract: MUI Button preserves the action footprint while loading and focused tests protect the retained button contract.

omittedStates.Refreshing: The consuming history collection retains loaded entries and owns refresh feedback.
omittedStates.Empty: An individual history entry cannot represent an empty collection.
omittedStates.Error: History request failure and recovery belong to the consuming collection boundary.

omittedStates.Loaded: Default documents the idle confirmation decision.
omittedStates.Refreshing: Busy actions do not own refresh state.
omittedStates.Empty: A confirmation requires target context and therefore has no empty state.
omittedStates.Error: Mutation errors are owned by the provider or consuming mutation while the dialog restores retry and cancel.
omittedStates.AlignmentContract: The dialog frame and target context remain mounted; focused tests protect its pending geometry and exit locks.

omittedStates.Refreshing: General retained refresh is application-owned; the table owns only content-preserving incremental pagination.
omittedStates.Error: The application supplies recoverable error presentation through the table content-region contract.

omittedStates.Loaded: Default demonstrates the complete pending-to-ready lifecycle and restart behavior.
omittedStates.Refreshing: Initialization gates first readiness and does not model background refresh.
omittedStates.Empty: Initialization readiness has no data-empty state.
omittedStates.AlignmentContract: Unknown initialized descendants require a declared Level C progress treatment rather than invented geometry.

omittedStates.Refreshing: The boundary exposes a generic loading flag; the consumer decides whether retained content represents refresh.
omittedStates.Empty: Empty presentation belongs to the content owner inside the region.
omittedStates.Error: Error and recovery presentation belongs to the content owner inside the region.
omittedStates.AlignmentContract: The boundary owns no content geometry and therefore cannot declare anchors for arbitrary children.

omittedStates.Loaded: Default demonstrates the successful Suspense transition and real query content.
omittedStates.Refreshing: Suspense initial loading is owned here; retained query refresh remains consumer-owned.
omittedStates.Empty: Query result emptiness is domain-specific and belongs to the successful child content.
omittedStates.AlignmentContract: Unknown Suspense descendants require a declared Level C progress treatment rather than invented geometry.
